instructions.update_frequency: Annually — every December for the following year
instructions.source: NSE India official circular — nseindia.com > About NSE > Investor Relations > Circulars > Search 'trading holidays <year>'
update_steps: 1. Download the official NSE holiday circular every December
2. Add the new year's holidays to the 'holidays' array below
4. Restart the SMB Algo app — holiday cache reloads automatically
5. Verify on dashboard — holiday calendar status shows green
instructions.warning: Past holidays can be removed once the year is over. Always keep current + next year loaded.
